name: Screen tenants and sign leases
summary: Takes a tenant applicant from enquiry through screening checks to a tenancy queued in Re-Leased, ready to sign. Crons read, check the record and queue; a person approves every tenancy before it is created.

all.evidence: 1 of 6 tenant screening calls describes the process step by step: lease preparation, lease signing and record keeping are all done by hand

covered_by.id-check: skill (done in the agency's own check tool, result recorded by the CRM shell)
covered_by.shortlist-decision: approval (a person sets the applicant approved with lease dates)
covered_by.lease-signing: not covered (no e-signature operation in Re-Leased)
covered_by.record-keeping: check-record (reads the record) and the Re-Leased contact and tenancy as the record

crons.name: check-record
crons.summary: Reads each new applicant's record and moves it on to the checks, or parks it when it has no usable email.

crons.name: lease
crons.summary: Queues a tenancy for each applicant a person has approved. Nothing is created until approved.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. A tenancy is a live operation because it creates a legal record that the tenant and the owner see; it waits for a person.

re-leased.covers: applicant contacts by tag, one contact read, and a tenancy created after approval

gaps: Console Cloud (Reapit PM) and PropertyMe: their help centres were read and show partial support for inspections, lease renewals and tenant references, but neither has a kit adapter or mapped operations. Build an adapter before either can run here.

Enquiries from listing sites or email: Re-Leased has no enquiry endpoint, so the intake cron only sees contacts already tagged as applicants. A mailbox intake needs the Microsoft 365 adapter, which is tied to the quoting types and is not reused here.

Application form, ID check, income, credit, guarantor and reference checks: done outside the platform. AgentBox (Reapit Foundations) maps identity checks and signed documents in the kit, but no adapter is built for it yet.
Applicant outcome notices: sending them is a live step. It needs a mailbox adapter that drafts, then queues the send for approval.
Lease signing: Re-Leased's mapped operations have no e-signature step, so signing stays manual.
Bond lodgement, key handover and advance rent: not mapped for Re-Leased.

Runtime: the approval result only keeps ids named id, uuid, *ID or *_id. Re-Leased returns GlobalIdentifier for a new tenancy, so the created tenancy id is not recorded. A change in core/workflows/runtime.ts is needed. Not made here.
Recording a screening decision: no command sets an applicant to approved with lease dates yet. The CRM shell must do it before the lease cron can queue anything.
Contacts: the intake cron reads the first page of tagged contacts only. Later pages are not followed.
Re-Leased is status spec and has not been run against a real account. The test uses a fake network only.

evidence.calls: 6 tenant screening calls were read; 1 describes the process step by step, and it is manual at every step it covers
evidence.platforms: Console Cloud (Reapit PM) and PropertyMe help centres were read; neither has mapped operations in the kit, so the kit's Re-Leased mapping is the only adapter built
